result.summary: A fresh remote-equal Windows checkout reconstructs and validates the immutable Phase Four package, installs the exact locked candidate wheel, passes the tracked-only regression, and exercises an exact detached rollback to the verified v0.54 tag.
result.phase_six_effect: P5O1-T01-U06 becomes eligible; this report does not itself accept or release a Phase Five candidate.

clean_source.path_class: ignored repository-local short path; private machine path withheld
clean_source.head: 75d1b77ed8a3faf0cbcf75b7f049fdb5afa9b115

candidate_wheel.release_identity: commit-bound Phase Five candidate; not a new v0.54 release

naive_clean_clone.cause: The tracked-only clone intentionally lacks ignored dataset/provider/context/intermediate custody used by five builder files and two exact-custody assertions.

retained_attempts.result: PowerShell promoted normal Git clone progress on stderr to a terminating error and interrupted checkout before the index existed.
A full run-name nested checkout exceeded Git-for-Windows path handling for several tracked retained-failure filenames. The short repo-local path with core.longpaths=true passed.

A naive wheel install resolved four transitive versions newer than uv.lock, and the first import probe resolved from the canonical working directory. The exact-lock, no-deps wheel install from a neutral directory passed.
The first clean-root validation imported the commit-identical module from the canonical checkout. The gate now requires its executing module to load from the exact clean source; r004 passed.

The locked tag runtime uses setuptools 82.0.0 and produced deterministic b20c517d... wheels. Exact comparison with the retained historical wheel isolated the difference to WHEEL generator metadata and RECORD. A build-only setuptools 82.0.1 environment reproduced ad3ae7c8... exactly.

known_issue.description: The Phase Four release audit recorded the fixed epoch and wheel hash but omitted the setuptools 82.0.1 builder identity embedded in the historical wheel.
known_issue.impact: The locked v0.54 runtime alone produces a semantically equivalent but byte-different wheel.
known_issue.workaround: Use the verified build-only setuptools 82.0.1 identity with the recorded source date epoch and hash seed when exact historical wheel reconstruction is required.

limitations: This reconstructs the immutable tracked package and release contracts; it does not retrain or retune any analytical method.
Prototype labels are owner-approved evidence, not independent ground truth.
The trained U-Net remains rejected and did not outperform RBR.
The WCP-002 result remains visible false-positive-risk evidence for RBR.
No accuracy, field-validation, official, operational, endorsed, emergency-ready, vulnerability-free, or final-submission-ready claim is made.
next_dependency: P5O1-T01-U06 freeze one baseline-first candidate, complete known-issues and QA evidence, and make the Phase Six recommendation
